title: AI Code Production Survival: Research Design and Measurement Specification
summary: Waydev - AI Code Production Survival: Research Design and Measurement Specification
body_markdown:
Every released estimate must include the number of participating organizations and eligible units, observation dates, numerator and denominator, uncertainty, cohort eligibility, integration coverage and limitations.


This page contains hypotheses and methods only. The publication will be updated with verified aggregate findings after data access approval, extraction, quality review and statistical analysis.
